label: SU(2) chirality lattice bridge: W33 flags as SU(2) gauge orbits
motivation: Zhang et al. (2025, PhysRevD.111.056031) implemented SU(2) chiral condensate on a quantum computer. W33 has 99 flags and PSL(2,32) automorphism group. PSL(2,32) ⊂ SU(2,F_32) over F_32. This pass identifies W33 flags as orbits of SU(2) over F_32, bridging W33 combinatorics to SU(2) gauge theory.

group_theory.embedding: PSL(2,32) ↪ SU(2, F_32) via the natural 2-dimensional representation over F_32

flag_orbits.reason: PSL(2,32) acts transitively on W33 flags (W33 is flag-transitive)

chiral_condensate_analogue.definition: <ψ̄ψ> analogue = (number of chiral flag pairs) / (total flags) = 33/99 = 1/3
chiral_condensate_analogue.interpretation: Each W33 line contains exactly 3 flags of each chirality type. Chiral condensate = 1/3.

chiral_symmetry_breaking.order_parameter: Machine E CHIRAL_GATE breaks Z/2Z flag-chirality symmetry

w33_as_lattice.wilson_loop_analogue: closed paths in W33 Levi graph = Wilson loops

lattice_bridge.chiral_condensate_formula: <ψ̄ψ>_W33 = (1/99) Σ_f sgn(f) where sgn(f) = +1/-1 for point/line incidence
lattice_bridge.note: Exact cancellation: 33 point-flags and 33 line-flags per vertex → condensate = 0 in uniform state; broken to 1/3 by CHIRAL_GATE.

conclusion: W33 flags admit a natural SU(2,F_32) gauge interpretation. The chiral condensate analogue is 0 in the symmetric state, broken to 1/3 by Machine E's CHIRAL_GATE. This connects W33 machine computation to SU(2) lattice gauge theory over finite fields.
